incompatibility_warning: Different methods can output conflicting numeric counts, multiply by fertile sign, or reclassify failed legal-marriage forecasts as concubines. No prospective deterministic priority, exception ordering, definition of spouse, number-of-planet eligibility or decoy baseline is specified. Cannot select retrospectively.
validation_preconditions: Independently acquire true spouses' registered marriage chronology and exact nativity time
Define whether marriages legally registered, unions, or non-marital partners before predictions
Freeze exactly one deterministic priority tree (including fallback cases and tie/no-score) before any person's outcomes are revealed
Check attributed Ptolemy passage independently before claims of inter-author support
Use independent blinded persons with matched marriage-number and non-astrology baselines
Preserve explicit predictions of one, two, three or more, and record full confusion matrix and misses
